title: A rep whose switch is turned off stays and reads (Inactive)
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} is open and not invoiced; it has one approved labor line and one part, and its one "Sales Representative" field reads {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-40001.
  • Starting screen: Settings > Staff is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open {Sales-rep-B}'s staff record, turn the "Sales Representative" switch off and save.
  2. Open {Work-order-1}.
  3. Click the Sales Representative field.
  4. Click on an empty part of the page to close the dropdown.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the staff record saves.
  • Step 2: the Sales Representative field reads "{Sales-rep-B} (Inactive)".
  • Step 3: {Sales-rep-B} is not in the dropdown, and no option is checked.
  • Step 4: the field still reads "{Sales-rep-B} (Inactive)"; nothing changed.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10890; story SV-11265 (Story 1, Give a work order its sales representative); PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 8 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S1-E2, read 19 Oct 2026. Source-verified 19 October 2026. The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-E2: “A person whose Sales Representative switch was turned off, or whose staff account was deactivated, stays in the field until someone changes it. The field reads their name followed by "(Inactive)", for example "Elliot Brennan (Inactive)". They are not offered in the dropdown, so no option is checked while they hold the field.”
